events.what: Portugal and Web Summit agree to keep the event in Lisbon until 2028; the state pays 11 million euros a year, split between Lisbon's tourism fund and the Ministry of Economy.
An evaluation by the Ministry of Economy's Office for Economic Studies finds the 2016 to 2019 editions' impact well below the first estimate.
EY's report on Web Summit's ten Lisbon years is released at the press conference: 2,492 million euros of impact.
